title: cal commits --json
description: Commits inferred from this repo's threads, newest first.

schema_version.description: Major version of this payload's shape. A reader refuses a version newer than it knows.

results.description: The rows, best match (or newest) first.

notice.description:
Present only when `results` is empty because this machine couldn't run the query (no
embedding model for `decisions` / `gotchas`), so a reader can tell that from no match.

bestOverlap.description: Strongest file-overlap among the linked threads (confidence proxy).

threadCount.description: How many threads link to this commit.

TimelineRow.description: One commit in a project's timeline, grouped across the threads it was inferred from.
